01 / About

Who I Am

I am a final-year Civil Engineering student at Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology (GIKI), graduating in 2026 with a CGPA of 3.71/4.00.

My work spans structural analysis, finite element modelling, seismic design, and geotechnical engineering. I approach every project with precision — translating complex computational models into real-world engineering decisions.

I am seeking professional exposure where I can apply advanced FEM tools, contribute to meaningful infrastructure, and grow alongside experienced engineers.

Foldable Pedestrian Bridge Prototype

BIM / Revit

Mosque & Residential 3D Modelling

Seismic Retrofitting

RC Building Retrofitting — Shear Wall Study

Comparative ETABS study of four shear wall configurations (25–100% height) using earthquake load patterns and nonlinear time-history analysis. The 75% case proved most economical — controlling drift, base shear, and eliminating the soft-zone effect in upper stories.

View Project Files on Drive ↗
Irrigation Engineering

High-Efficiency Irrigation Design App

FAO-56 Penman-Monteith based tool covering full drip/sprinkler system design — crop water requirements, Hazen-Williams hydraulic pipe sizing, pump TDH calculation, and O&M scheduling. Built for water-scarce desert agriculture in DI Khan, Pakistan.

View Project Files on Drive ↗
Construction Management

Primavera P6 Scheduling & Earned Value Analysis

Full CPM baseline schedule for a 1-Kanal double-story residential house (103 working days, 20 activities, PKR 4.85M budget) in Primavera P6. Includes resource-loaded WBS, Day-75 delay scenario triggered by monsoon disruption, tri-curve S-curve (BCWS/BCWP/ACWP), all 8 EVA metrics (SPI 0.768, CPI 0.925, EAC PKR 5.24M), and a 3-measure recovery schedule recovering 8–10 days.
